settings.raw_html:
The case study

Hexa Labs had a strong product and a quiet market. In nine weeks a team of five turned one small wearable into a launch people passed around: a film, a fast landing page and an email flow that kept the interest warm.

01
01/03

Intro and the brief

Hexa Labs had built a black hex wearable and booked a launch date. They asked us for one story strong enough to carry a film, a site and every post.

02
02/03

Cutting through noise

Wearables blur together in a busy feed. We had nine weeks to make a small black object worth stopping for, and then worth sharing.

03
03/03

Impact after launch

The launch film passed 1.2M views, the landing page converted three times better, and email sign-ups grew 48% after release.

settings.raw_html:
What the launch did for Hexa Labs

1.2M

Views of the launch film across social channels, paid placements and the website.

3x

Conversion on the new launch page, tracked from the day it went live.

48%

Growth in email sign-ups as the film found its audience.

We agreed the success metrics before a single frame was cut. The film brought the reach, the page did the converting, and a simple email flow kept new fans close until the wearable reached their door.
